rules: Pick the single most specific subcategory that fits; never fall back to a domain name alone.
Unsorted/To Review is only for captures with no identifiable subject.
A new subtopic requires a new entry here plus a MOC section — do not invent folder names ad hoc.

subtopics.name: MCP & Agent Tooling
subtopics.description: MCP servers/clients, tool protocols, connectors, and tools or APIs built specifically to be called by agents (browser control, web access, cookie/tool bridges).

subtopics.name: Skills & Prompts
subtopics.description: Agent skills (SKILL.md packs, skill managers, skill generators), prompt engineering, system prompts and instruction frameworks.

subtopics.name: Coding Agents & Harnesses
subtopics.description: Coding agents and their harnesses: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Grok Build, AI IDEs, AI code review, context/compaction management for coding agents.

subtopics.name: Agentic Systems
subtopics.description: Agent architecture and orchestration: multi-agent teams, agent memory, persistence, graph engineering, control planes, autonomous runtimes.

subtopics.name: RAG, Search & Data
subtopics.description: Retrieval-augmented generation, vector indexes/embeddings, crawlers and scrapers, knowledge graphs, deep-research retrieval, search over your own data.

subtopics.name: Multimodal & Generation
subtopics.description: Image, video, audio, speech and 3D generation or understanding: diffusion models, TTS/STT models, OCR, vision, upscalers, mocap, 3D reconstruction.

subtopics.name: Models & Research
subtopics.description: Model releases, reviews and benchmarks; training, inference and quantization; papers and ML theory; eval harnesses.

subtopics.name: Free Access & Cost
subtopics.description: Free tiers, free APIs and credits, model routers/proxies, and cost-reduction tactics for LLM usage.

subtopics.name: Web & Frontend
subtopics.description: Frontend frameworks, browser APIs, CSS/animation on the web, Three.js/3D web, web components, UI performance.

subtopics.name: Backend, APIs & Architecture

subtopics.name: Dev Tools & Editors

subtopics.name: Learning & Fundamentals

subtopics.name: Career & Skill Strategy
